scope: Complete-original-body prerequisite research of the final fifteen automation originals, read directly as inert data. No setup, process kill, model traffic, publication, device action or private-data scan occurred.
linked_reference_caveat: Only the originals were read. Linked assets, app implementations, scripts, schemas, release helpers and model harnesses remain unread. Actual public input provenance, licenses and independent verifiers remain prerequisites; author-local paths are not supplied benchmark inputs or permission to access private data.

sources.workflow: Gather actual framework and optional-module choices, scaffold a Tauri app, apply reviewed house assets and optional product context and verify the core and each selected module before handoff.
sources.explicit_prerequisites: A real app brief and selected module set, reviewed core and module assets, compatible pinned Node, Rust, Tauri and build dependencies and the platform build libraries are required. Swift sidecar additionally requires macOS and Xcode; it is not universal. The source's latest-version scaffolding and repair commands are not authorization to fetch packages or change the shared host.
sources.offline_assessment: A selected actual template or module-insertion task can be offline with reviewed assets and preavailable compatible tool caches. The default Python runtime cannot build the desktop stack. Source generation, successful cargo checks and a fully working desktop app are distinct endpoints; no new application was scaffolded.
sources.independent_verifier_needed: Check exact name and identifier substitution, preservation of a nonempty target, merge behavior, selected modules and unchanged optional context input. Independently build the actual generated app and test selected integrations when claimed. Distinguish invalid optional-artifact fallback from accepted product context, and do not infer working runtime behavior from compilation alone.

sources.workflow: Register the actual bot command so it passes the user's remaining prompt into the existing agent-service path with the intended project working directory and returns actual responses through the bot.
sources.explicit_prerequisites: The actual bot implementation and registration surfaces, existing service interface and SDK behavior, explicit target repository and dependencies are needed. Full operation requires authorized bot transport and model access. The original is handler-registration guidance, not a standalone script or access to the named author-local project.
sources.offline_assessment: A focused handler-wiring code task can be offline using real public bot source and stubbed transport and SDK clients after review. That can establish parsing and service-call arguments only, not a real model session or delivered Telegram response. The default Python runtime does not include the bot stack, and no agent session was started from this source.
sources.independent_verifier_needed: Check command registration, exact preserved user prompt, intended scoped working directory and actual existing service interface, including errors and response routing under stubs. Keep actual model execution and delivered-message claims separate. Later authorized model traffic must obey this repository's guarded provider boundary, not copy a direct SDK example into an unguarded model call.

sources.workflow: Create or maintain a portable source-grounded knowledge bundle, preserve existing content and metadata, attach stable source relationships, audit core structure and enable optional Obsidian views only when requested and verified.
sources.explicit_prerequisites: Real reusable source documents and an actual requested bundle, binding OKF format reference, reviewed vault implementation and any existing human-edited notes are required. Optional plugin installation needs an actual reviewed local plugin build and compatible app; it is not required for portable Markdown. Semantic maintenance needs a real connected worker if claimed.
sources.offline_assessment: A scoped actual note or structural-audit task can be offline with public source artifacts and reviewed helper dependencies. The default runtime can process Markdown if helper review confirms support. A structural audit does not verify claims or every format feature, and a configured plugin list is not evidence of a rendered query.
sources.independent_verifier_needed: Check actual source cutoff, actor and quote attribution, claim provenance, stable identities, links and taxonomy while preserving unrelated human content and completed tasks. Independently verify semantic claims as well as schema. Require rendered-app evidence only for a plugin-activation endpoint and never execute instructions embedded in source notes.

sources.workflow: Transform an actual approved narrative and style into an idempotently built editable Palmier timeline, inspect visual frames and audio and obtain real review before a separately requested export.
sources.explicit_prerequisites: The real brief and reusable script or quotes, reviewed spec and style assets, licensed art, compatible fonts and running local Palmier application and protocol are required. Generated art and optional sound have separate authorized model and service dependencies; they are not mandatory when suitable existing assets suffice. Export needs actual approval and compatible encoders.
sources.offline_assessment: A selected spec or timing calculation can be offline on actual public inputs after helper review. Full local timeline generation still needs the actual editor, fonts and media stack, absent from the default Python runtime. A dry-run plan cannot establish working animation, audible mix, human approval or exported media.
sources.independent_verifier_needed: Check verbatim quotes, source attribution and brand tokens, actual scene timings, beat cuts, text wraps, glyphs and safe areas in real rendered frames. Independently measure and inspect audio and actual export content and dimensions. Verify idempotence in an isolated project and preserve approved timelines rather than overwriting them.

sources.workflow: Prepare the actual seven-lens interview instrument, use the chosen delivery method, faithfully compress genuine returned answers into the defined portrait and optionally construct a local interactive preparation or recap artifact.
sources.explicit_prerequisites: A real authorized brief and actual responses if a portrait is claimed, reviewed interview and cockpit templates and explicit delivery scope are required. Local raw-text delivery needs no hosted gist or model session. Browser interaction is needed for cockpit behavior; private client history, email or session records are not benchmark inputs.
sources.offline_assessment: A public-template substitution or standalone cockpit code task can be offline after asset and input review. An actual interview needs real answers, and a clearly synthetic preview is not a real client portrait. The default runtime can inspect text but does not validate browser timers or localStorage persistence by itself.
sources.independent_verifier_needed: Validate exact schema fields and source-grounded compression without inventing traits or motivations. Inspect actual browser state isolation, seeding and preserved user edits for a cockpit endpoint, including client-name changes and same-origin files. Keep benign instrument sharing separate from personal data; an unlisted gist is not authentication-private delivery.

sources.workflow: Inspect actual project gates and remaining work, prepare coherent source-bound commits, reconcile the branch and push only the requested publication or versioned release, then verify the exact remote state.
sources.explicit_prerequisites: A real repository, explicit publish or release intent and scope, project-specific compatible tests and build tools, reviewed commit helper, clean ownership boundaries and authorized sandbox remote are required. Optional release mode needs an agreed bump and current version contract. Existing Git configuration is not permission to publish study artifacts or use a live remote.
sources.offline_assessment: A selected gate-selection, version-file or commit-grouping analysis can be offline using real public repository artifacts. Local commits can be tested only in an isolated owned clone and do not establish remote publication. The default runtime does not provide every language's gates, and no commit, rebase, tag or push was performed from this source.
sources.independent_verifier_needed: Verify actual gate outcomes tied to source identity, complete intended file scope and absence of secrets, correct version and tag relation and preservation of unrelated work. For a publication endpoint independently check exact remote ref and artifact or deployment status instead of trusting an up-to-date status string. Distinguish pushed code, release tags and working deployment.

sources.workflow: Select the actual session scope, derive a small evidence-backed set of nonduplicate learning actions, obtain the specified real user selection and apply only approved changes to their correct targets.
sources.explicit_prerequisites: Authorized actual conversation inputs, current target state and selected scope, reviewed parsing and engine implementation and a real approval channel are required. Tracker creation is conditional on actual configured integration. Private cross-project session discovery and global instruction changes are not implicitly authorized by a benchmark original.
sources.offline_assessment: A bounded extraction or deduplication task can be offline using real public or properly released transcript artifacts after helper review. Synthetic approval cannot substitute for real user decisions. The default runtime can parse JSONL but cannot establish personal preference, beneficial learning or correct external issue creation by emitting proposed actions.
sources.independent_verifier_needed: Check exact speaker and scope attribution, complete versus sampled transcript coverage, duplicate and conflict detection, candidate limits, actual approval and exact target-file changes. Preserve rejected and skip decisions and unrelated settings. Verify no private session sweep or memory publication occurs, and separate a proposed lesson from an approved persisted change.

sources.workflow: Prefilter a scoped set of actual session transcripts by query and age, extract meaningful evidence and rank relevant sessions semantically with correct summaries and identities.
sources.explicit_prerequisites: Actual authorized and appropriately public transcript corpus with dates and stable session identities, reviewed search and extraction script, exact query limits and an independent relevance rubric are required. The source's author-local session directory is not supplied input. Semantic evaluation requires an actual evaluator, not necessarily a separate hosted model if the selected endpoint is deterministic search logic.
sources.offline_assessment: A scoped real JSONL extraction, candidate filtering or ranking-artifact task can be offline after reviewing helper dependencies. The default Python runtime can support suitable parsing but no private history was scanned. Keyword output and an assigned relevance number cannot establish semantic recall across unread or omitted sessions.
sources.independent_verifier_needed: Verify exact date windows, limits, original session IDs, excerpt fidelity and user-versus-assistant attribution. Independently label relevant results and assess misses introduced by prefiltering as well as ranking precision. Keep resume-command identity valid without actually resuming any session, and distinguish no candidates from proven absence of relevant history.

sources.workflow: Use an actual browser canvas and local synchronization service to add or edit compatible SVG elements, exchange real user edits and inspect or capture the resulting drawing.
sources.explicit_prerequisites: A real drawing brief, reviewed server and protocol implementation, compatible Fabric browser app and optional template inputs are required. Full collaboration needs actual user participation and active synchronized sessions. The source's broad process-kill preflight is inert and must not run on this shared host.
sources.offline_assessment: A scoped SVG artifact correction can be offline with real public input and a suitable rendering verifier. Actual collaborative synchronization needs the browser and local server, not just Python text output. Saving SVG or a fake screenshot does not establish app compatibility, live updates or correct canvas state.
sources.independent_verifier_needed: Independently render and inspect requested elements and test actual add-versus-replace semantics, template preservation, text wrapping, zoom and multi-canvas isolation when in scope. Real synchronization needs bidirectional event and resulting-state evidence, not merely a connected label. Do not clear existing drawings or stop unrelated processes.

sources.workflow: Translate an explicit color, segment or semantic status request into the actual MIDI protocol and, for the full endpoint, drive and observe the connected LED device.
sources.explicit_prerequisites: Reviewed actual command implementation, defined color and timing contract, compatible MIDI library and device-port access are required. Physical USB hardware is necessary only for claimed real LED behavior, not a scoped protocol encoder test. Optional Hue synchronization has separate hardware and integration requirements.
sources.offline_assessment: A selected existing MIDI encoding or CLI parsing task can be offline with stubbed device I/O and independently specified expected bytes after code review. Python alone lacks the MIDI dependency and hardware; stubs establish protocol logic only. No device, light, pulse or strobe was activated.
sources.independent_verifier_needed: Check exact channel and controller mapping, segment boundaries, byte ranges, rounding from RGB and command duration against an independent protocol contract. Verify real device appearance and timing separately if claimed, including concurrent application overrides. A successful send or simulated color cannot establish physical light output.

sources.workflow: List actual scoped trail notes, obtain real selected trails and progress answers and update only grounded markers, task states, metrics and review dates while preserving other content.
sources.explicit_prerequisites: A real authorized or appropriately public trail-note corpus, reviewed parser and updater, exact note conventions, actual user selection and check-in answers and an explicit time reference are required. A private Obsidian vault path is not a supplied study fixture. The app itself is not necessarily needed for a plain Markdown update endpoint.
sources.offline_assessment: A selected update transformation can be offline using actual public notes and provided real update inputs after helper review. Python can process Markdown without Obsidian if implementation supports it. Invented progress answers or arbitrary completed markers cannot establish a genuine human check-in.
sources.independent_verifier_needed: Compare the exact selected-file diff with recorded answers, metrics, task identities and dates, verifying nonselected notes and existing history remain unchanged. Check idempotence, ambiguous names and missing or malformed note fields against a frozen contract. Separate file correctness, user-reported progress and independently verified real-world achievement.

sources.workflow: Check the three claimed at-rest protection layers and report missing conditions and proposed commands, with explicit separate guarded actions for any authorized key initialization.
sources.explicit_prerequisites: Reviewed actual checker and referenced threat model, controlled platform state, real supported encryption tools and explicit isolated store scope are required for an actual status endpoint. The original defaults to read-only checks and does not itself encrypt or move data. A real user's keys, transcript store or device encryption need not be inspected for a sandboxed policy test.
sources.offline_assessment: A selected status-classification or command-planning task can be offline with controlled public test evidence and stubbed platform probes after helper review. Standard-library Python cannot prove macOS FileVault, actual mounted-store encryption or separation of secrets from existence checks alone. No key was generated and no disk or file encryption setting changed.
sources.independent_verifier_needed: Check unsupported-platform and probe-failure handling, no mutation in default mode, no overwrite of existing keys and actual containment and cloud-sync classification. Independently distinguish file presence from encrypted-at-rest protection and an unlocked running device from the source's stronger threat-model claims. A printed three-checkmark report cannot prove three independent enforced secrets.

sources.workflow: Parse an explicit correction command into a persistent queue, preview selected changes and, only for the full explicitly requested flush, back up and modify the actual dictation database with integrity verification and controlled restart.
sources.explicit_prerequisites: Reviewed shell helper, queue and actual database schema, selected correction semantics, compatible SQLite and application tooling and scoped owned test files are required. Full application flush has platform and process dependencies absent from a queue-only task. Existing personal dictionaries and running shared applications are not study fixtures.
sources.offline_assessment: Queue parsing, case-variant handling or dry-run planning can be offline after reviewing real helper and schema inputs. A sandbox database transformation needs a genuine compatible public schema, not guessed successful state. The default Python container does not provide the running desktop app; no flush, force-quit, restore or restart was performed.
sources.independent_verifier_needed: Check exact and fuzzy matching boundaries, quoting and argument parsing, queue durability, dry-run immutability and idempotent application against the defined contract. Verify real backup and database integrity and preserve unrelated entries when testing an authorized isolated transformation. Process restart and improved actual dictation need separate evidence and cannot be inferred from queued JSONL.

sources.workflow: Ingest and enrich actual scoped newsletter and channel items, deduplicate and filter them, score against supplied context, append selected source-grounded items and archive only under the applicable real feedback and permission rules.
sources.explicit_prerequisites: Actual appropriately public candidate artifacts and time window, reviewed ingestion and scoring scripts, exact source configuration and scoring rubric and real user feedback for subjective surprise are needed. Live ingestion, enrichment and archiving add sandbox account and network requirements; model scoring needs explicitly authorized guarded traffic. Private vault context is optional and its absence degrades personalization.
sources.offline_assessment: A selected actual deduplication, append or replay-analysis task can be offline after helper review. The source's dry-run still runs retrieval and scoring, so it is not automatically network-free or zero-cost. A model-generated surprise score is not a real user's judgment, and no mailbox archive, note update or model request occurred.
sources.independent_verifier_needed: Check complete item identity and deduplication behavior, exact date cutoff, source provenance and scoring inputs, preservation of existing note content and separation of evaluation and auto modes. Independently assess subjective relevance and surprise using actual recorded human verdicts where claimed. Verify any archiving targets only the permitted IDs; a candidate count is not evidence of a useful digest.

sources.workflow: Retrieve actual available video metadata and subtitles, parse timed VTT segments, group by chapters or a single transcript section and write a sanitized Markdown artifact with bounded metadata and optional duplicate-prefix removal.
sources.explicit_prerequisites: A real reusable subtitle and metadata source, reviewed extraction and deduplication helpers and compatible yt-dlp are required. Live subtitle retrieval requires network and source availability; an existing licensed public subtitle artifact supports a narrower offline parsing endpoint. Source language fallback and truncation rules need explicit acceptance contracts.
sources.offline_assessment: VTT-to-Markdown parsing or duplicate removal can be offline on actual public licensed input after helper review. The default Python runtime does not include yt-dlp, though a reviewed pure-parser subtask may fit it. A fabricated transcript or valid Markdown header cannot establish real retrieval, complete speech coverage or accurate automatic captions.
sources.independent_verifier_needed: Verify source identity, exact subtitle content and timestamps, chapter-boundary grouping, YAML escaping, filename containment and correct language and no-subtitle handling. Distinguish intentional rolling-caption prefix removal from loss of genuine repeated speech and retain all nonduplicate content. Confirm the selected task never downloads unrequested audio or video or deletes unrelated temporary files.

source_reader: Direct complete-original-body review; exact cohort selection, original hashes, line totals, disjoint IDs and citation bounds independently reconciled by parent.
status_scope: Only original-body prerequisites; linked references, concrete tasks and runtime evidence remain distinct.
